# SOP-P3-L1-03 First-article inspection - Hot Forge line

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-HP01, EQ-P3-L1-SB02, EQ-P3-L1-IH03

1. Purpose
   1.1 Define the first-article inspection sequence for hot forging operations on P3-L1.

2. Preconditions
   2.1 Production order released and material received per ECN-2026-006.  
   2.2 Machine maintenance completed per MM-P3-L1-SB02 and MM-P3-L1-SB02-S3.  
   2.3 Verify that the target billet temperature for Hot Forge induction billet heater #3 (EQ-P3-L1-IH03) is 1260 °C.  
   2.4 Verify lubricant reservoir filled with CFW-LUB-927 for Hot Forge hydraulic forging press #1 (EQ-P3-L1-HP01).

3. PPE
   3.1 Required: heat-resistant gloves, face shield, hearing protection, safety boots, and apron.  
   3.2 Confirm PPE is in good condition before entry to the hot work area.

4. First-article inspection steps
   4.1 Set up fixturing and datum references according to engineering drawing and ECN-2026-006.  
   4.2 Verify induction heater EQ-P3-L1-IH03 achieves specified billet condition as noted in 2.3 prior to transfer.  
   4.3 Transfer billet to EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and confirm handling safety interlocks active.  
   4.4 Cycle press on single test stroke on EQ-P3-L1-HP01 using CFW-LUB-927 lubrication per maintenance guidance.  
   4.5 Remove first-article forging, perform dimensional and visual inspection against drawing requirements and record findings.  
   4.6 If nonconformance exists, stop production and document per ECN-2026-006; do not proceed until disposition approved.

5. Data collection and records
   5.1 Record measured dimensions, material lot, equipment IDs, and inspector initials on the inspection record.  
   5.2 Attach inspection record to the production lot file.

6. Sign-off
   6.1 Inspector name: ______________________  Signature: ______________________  Date: ______________________  
   6.2 Supervisor name: ______________________  Signature: ______________________  Date: ______________________

Related documents: ECN-2026-006, MM-P3-L1-SB02, MM-P3-L1-SB02-S3
